label: Low income tax offset, maximum
quote: $37,500 or less, you will get the maximum offset of $700
notes: The page names no income year. The table in ITAA 1997 s 61-115(1), substituted by the Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Relief So Working Australians Keep More Of Their Money) Act 2019 (No. 52, 2019) Sch 1 item 3, gives the $700 maximum. The Treasury Laws Amendment (A Tax Plan for the COVID-19 Economic Recovery) Act 2020 (No. 92, 2020) Sch 1 items 19 and 24 apply it from the 2020-21 income year: https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2020A00092/asmade
